# Business interruption in logistics cyber

Logistics BI losses concentrate on dispatch capability, not data. A WMS
outage halts revenue across every dependent site simultaneously - single
points of failure multiply exposure across locations. Pricing should load
for system concentration (sites per system), and restoration time drives
loss more than ransom economics where offline backups are tested.

channel into NovaFreight's warehouse management system. Ransomware
encrypted WMS servers on 2024-06-09; all 14 sites lost dispatch capability
for 9 days. Offline backups held - restoration, not ransom, ended the
outage.

Business-interruption loss EUR 1.7M, incident-response EUR 0.4M. Coverage
was disputed under CY-EX-04 and resolved for the insured (see coverage.md).
Settled EUR 2.1M on 2024-11-21.

Assessment: the loss itself was well within modelled ransomware scenarios.
What was not modelled was the entry path - vendor standing access. That is
the lesson this case leaves behind.

# First notification of loss - NovaFreight Logistics BV

Received via placing broker, 2024-06-09 16:40 CET.

At approximately 03:00 CET the insured's warehouse management system became
unavailable at all sites. On-screen messages at the Rotterdam operations
centre indicated file encryption and demanded contact through a payment
portal. The insured's IT provider confirmed ransomware affecting the WMS
production estate.

Dispatch is halted at all 14 warehouses. Receiving continues on paper at
reduced volume. The insured has activated its incident plan, isolated the
WMS network segment, and engaged its retained forensics firm.

A ransom demand of USD 1.2M in cryptocurrency was received. The insured
states its intention to restore from offline backups rather than engage
with the demand, subject to confirmation that backups are unaffected.

Initial loss indication: outage of 7 to 10 days across all sites.
Contractual penalty clauses with two major retail customers activate after
48 hours of missed dispatch windows.

Policy reference: cyber policy bound February 2024 (submission
SUB-2024-018). Notification within policy terms.

All agents on this platform follow these rules. Domain and case AGENTS.md
files extend them - they never repeat them.

## Behaviour
- Cite a source for every factual claim: a source note, a chunk ID from the
  query index, or an entity ID from the knowledge graph. No source, no claim.
- Mark inference explicitly. Facts read from documents are stated plainly;
  conclusions you derived are prefixed "Assessment:".
- When evidence conflicts, record both positions. Never silently resolve a
  conflict - flag it in open-questions.md and move on.
- Escalate to a human when: authority thresholds are exceeded, evidence
  conflicts block a conclusion, or confidence in a material claim is low.

## Vocabulary
- Peril and coverage labels come from wiki/vocabulary/ only. If no term
  fits, propose one in lessons.md - do not invent free text inline.

## Writing to the wiki
- Writes go through propose_wiki_update(). Direct file writes are for
  humans only.
- decisions.md is append-only. Never edit an existing decision record.
